chunks: Abu Abdillah al-Bazawfari from Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from Ja'far, from Ali ibn Uthman and Isḥaq ibn 'Ammar, from Sa'id ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about a man who has a female slave, and she has a daughter who is also a slave, and he buys her [the daughter]. Is it permissible for him to have sexual relations with her? He said: No.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.يَطْأَهَا: To have sexual relations with her

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a master having relations with the daughter of his own female slave?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies the specific application of 'illah (legal cause) in slave ownership, establishing that the prohibition of 'Umm al-Walad' (mother of the child) extends to the daughter when purchased by the same master. It highlights the juristic distinction between marriage prohibitions and sexual relations with slaves, affirming that the bond of ownership and lineage creates an immediate barrier to intimacy, a ruling confirmed by Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him).
